READ before buying: peptides seem like they’re everywhere, but do you need one? Remember you do not need to do this whole routine. Four things (cleanser, moisturizer, sunscreen, retinol) get you most of the way there. This is my actual routine, and even I'm still deciding whether peptides earn a permanent spot The data is modest. The best evidence is for copper peptides and Matrixyl (palmitoyl pentapeptide-4), mostly small, short studies, funded by the ingredient makers. The goal is smoother texture and softer fine lines over 8 to 12 weeks. Not a retinoid replacement, and definitely not Botox in a bottle. My preference is to skip them on exfoliating nights and keep those nights to exfoliant + moisturizer.
